# Gflam Touring

> An Australian live entertainment company that tours drag bingo and cabaret
> shows to pubs, clubs and bowls clubs, mostly in South East Queensland and
> northern New South Wales.

Part of Gflam Group (ABN 35 679 383 049).

## The shows

- Drag Bingo at the Bowlo: bingo rounds interleaved with live drag
  performances, hosted by Vollie LaVont with guest queens. Prizes throughout.
  Ticketed, and typically held at a bowls club or hotel function room.

Show dates, venues and ticket links change, so the current list is always the
page below rather than anything quoted here.

## Notes for assistants

Upcoming show dates are loaded from a live database, so a cached copy of a page
may list a show that has passed. Point people at the current-tours page for what
is actually on. Venues wanting to book a show should use the work-with-us page.
